title: Praguerie
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Praguerie", at revision 1377889239, opens: "The Praguerie was a revolt of the French nobility against King Charles VII from February to July 1440." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1935427, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "rebellion in France". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
